targets.name: Axeyum.Autogenesis.intHalfWitnessOfModTwoZeroLiftV1
targets.statement: forall n : Int, n % 2 = 0 -> exists m : Int, n = m + m

proof_route.nonnegative: reduce Int.ofNat addition and emod definitionally, then transport the corresponding closed Nat theorem through Int.ofNat
proof_route.negative_double: reduce negSucc addition/emod definitionally; natDouble plus succOne makes the remainder branch reflexive
proof_route.negative_half: use modCases to reject index remainder zero from the given Int remainder, use succZero and natHalf on index+1, then choose the negated natural witness and apply clean neg_add_rev

acceptance: Both parameterized constructor lifts compile under the narrow import without simp, omega, generic Int division decomposition, official Int.even_iff, or decision machinery.
stop_rule: Any elaboration failure stops after the one compilation and records the exact missing definitional or theorem boundary before another source version.
limitations: Compilation alone gives no footprint or closed integer theorem credit; export, audit, specialization, direction composition, and ledger mutation remain separate.
